name: Switch
summary: A binary on/off toggle whose change takes effect at once, like a physical switch. Choose it over a checkbox when there is no submit step, and over a toggle button when the setting has a persistent on/off meaning rather than an action.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: Controlled on/off state; when given, defaultChecked is ignored.

inputs.name: labelPosition
inputs.description: Where the label sits relative to the track.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Track 40 × 20px (medium) or 32 × 16px (small); small also shrinks the label to caption size.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Native input attribute: draws the disabled colours and takes no input.

inputs.name: disabledFocusable
inputs.description: Looks disabled and ignores toggling but stays in the tab order, reported through aria-disabled.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Called with the new checked boolean.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: An inline-flex row (a column when the label is above), aligned to the start, carrying the focus outline.

anatomy.name: Hidden input
anatomy.description: A transparent native checkbox over the track column (track plus spacingHorizontalS each side, full height); with the label above it spans the full width. It takes focus, native attributes and the pointer cursor.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: The indicator slot: a pill with a 1px border whose colour, fill and thumb colour carry every state.

anatomy.name: Thumb
anatomy.description: A circle icon inside the track, sized by the track's font size and coloured currentColor; it slides to the end when checked.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The text, centred on the track's line.

variants.description: Track 40 × 20px, thumb 18px travelling 20px; row 36px tall; label reads the Label default (body1).
Track 32 × 16px, thumb 14px travelling 16px; row 32px tall; label fontSizeBase200 on lineHeightBase200.
Label after the track, its start padding trimmed to spacingHorizontalXS.
Label before the track, its end padding trimmed to spacingHorizontalXS; the input covers the end column.
The root becomes a column; the label pads spacingVerticalXS above and below at full width and the track drops its top margin.

layout.text: The root is a relative inline-flex box aligned flex-start, a column when the label is above.

The track is a borderRadiusCircular pill with a 1px solid border, margin spacingVerticalS above and below and spacingHorizontalS either side, never shrinking and ignoring the pointer. Medium is 40 × 20px (a 36px row with its margins); small 32 × 16px (a 32px row).

The thumb is the track height minus 2px: 18px medium, 14px small, set as the track's font size with line height 0. Checked, it translates along the inline axis by track width − thumb − 2px: 20px medium, 16px small.

The hidden input is absolute, full height and track width plus 2 × spacingHorizontalS wide (56px medium, 48px small), at the track's side of the row; with the label above it spans the full width and the track height plus spacingVerticalS at the bottom.

The label pads spacingVerticalS by spacingHorizontalS (trimmed to spacingHorizontalXS toward the track) and takes a negative vertical margin of (track height − line height) / 2 so the first line centres on the track: lineHeightBase300 at medium, lineHeightBase200 at small.

states.text: Off at rest: track border and thumb colorNeutralStrokeAccessible on no fill; label colorNeutralForeground1.
Off: border and thumb colorNeutralStrokeAccessibleHover. On: fill colorCompoundBrandBackgroundHover and border colorTransparentStrokeInteractive. The label does not change.
While hovered and pressed. Off: border and thumb colorNeutralStrokeAccessiblePressed. On: fill colorCompoundBrandBackgroundPressed, border colorTransparentStrokeInteractive.
On: the track fills colorCompoundBrandBackground with a colorTransparentStroke border, the thumb turns colorNeutralForegroundInverted and slides to the end.

Keyboard focus draws the default createFocusOutlineStyle outline around the whole root (track and label): 2px colorStrokeFocus2 just outside it, rounded borderRadiusMedium; selector focus-within, following the input.

Disabled or aria-disabled: thumb and label colorNeutralForegroundDisabled, default cursor. Off: track border colorNeutralStrokeDisabled, no fill. On: track fill colorNeutralBackgroundDisabled with a colorTransparentStrokeDisabled border; the thumb stays at the end.

behaviour.text: A click on the track column or the label, or Space while focused, flips checked and calls onChange with the new value; the change is meant to apply immediately.
The track transitions background, border and color, and the thumb transitions transform, both over durationNormal with curveEasyEase; under reduced motion both run in 0.01ms.
disabledFocusable styles exactly like disabled (the rules match aria-disabled) but the input stays focusable and shows the focus outline.
The focus outline appears only for keyboard focus, never after a pointer press.

semantics: a native input type=checkbox with role switch, so checked reads as on/off
the label slot is a <label> bound to the input; a switch without one needs aria-label

notes.text: Track sizes (40 × 20, 32 × 16px), the 2px thumb gap, the thumb sizes and travel, and the 1px track border are constants in the styles file; the border does not read strokeWidthThin.
A medium switch row is 36px tall, not 32: the 20px track plus two spacingVerticalS margins. Only the small switch fits a 32px row.
With labelPosition above, the input's height uses the medium track height even at small size, so a small switch's hit area is 4px taller than its track row.
The off thumb is coloured by the stroke token (colorNeutralStrokeAccessible), the same as the border, not by a foreground token.

Under forced colours: the thumb is CanvasText (the icon opts out of forced adjustment); on is a Highlight track with a Canvas thumb, unchanged by hover and press; disabled turns thumb, border and label GrayText; the focus outline turns Highlight.
The thumb is a circle icon supplied by the render function (not vendored); the styles only size it by font size and colour it with currentColor.
